cause_quote: #196662 added prepareLocalWorkspaceCheckpointCapture for `options.reason === "checkpoint"`, which on btrfs runs `await nativeWorktreeFilesystem.copy(projectionPath, root, options)` to snapshot the workspace and `removeLocalWorkspaceCheckpointCapture` to retire it on every changed command checkpoint.
user_saw: On a btrfs host with large sandbox workspaces, the Gateway stalled after agent commands, with SQLite waits of 9-19.6 s and RPC p99 around 52 s.
summary: Removes per-command btrfs snapshot creation and retirement from sandbox command checkpoints, capturing changed checkpoints directly into an immutable Git result under a short guest pause.
reasoning: Before #196662 (10d67445), command checkpoints paused the guest and captured directly into Git, which is the behavior this fix restores; #196662 introduced the per-checkpoint btrfs snapshot and removal, and #196727 (d7f90ec3) only narrowed it to large or slow workspaces such as the production one. The fix cites a production incident of Gateway-wide stalls attributed to those snapshots. Confidence is medium because #196662 was a deliberate pause-versus-I/O trade-off and the btrfs mechanism was inferred, not measured natively.
